zh-Hans.headline: 直接写 Markdown
zh-Hans.subheadline: 直接输入 Markdown，标题、列表、加粗与代码块边写边呈现。

zh-Hans.headline: 用文字，把流程画出来
zh-Hans.subheadline: 用 Mermaid 画清流程和关系，改文字就能改图。

zh-Hans.headline: 公式和推导，写在一起
zh-Hans.subheadline: 行内公式、完整推导，用 LaTeX 和文字一起讲清楚。

zh-Hans.headline: 代码高亮，解释就在旁
zh-Hans.subheadline: 高亮代码，写清原理，让下次回看少一点猜测。

zh-Hans.headline: 文件夹归类，标签串联
zh-Hans.subheadline: 文件夹收好项目，层级标签和笔记链接串起相关想法。

zh-Hans.headline: 忘了原话，也能搜
zh-Hans.subheadline: 用自己的话描述想法，找回相关笔记，搜索留在本机。
zh-Hans.footnote: 支持中英文；加密笔记不参与语义索引。

zh-Hans.headline: 导入旧文档，导出新成果
zh-Hans.subheadline: PDF、Word 转为可编辑笔记，导出 PDF、Markdown。
zh-Hans.footnote: 支持含文本 PDF 与 Office 文档；复杂版式可能变化。

zh-Hans.headline: 多端同时改，正文自动合并
zh-Hans.subheadline: 手机补灵感，Mac 改计划；普通笔记的正文改动自动合并。
zh-Hans.footnote: 同一 Apple 账户开启 iCloud 同步；加密笔记保留并发版本。

zh-Hans.headline: 自定义主题，分享你的配色
zh-Hans.subheadline: 22 套主题全新调色，还能自己调；主题文件可导入、导出与分享。

zh-Hans.headline: 表格直接改，行列随手调
zh-Hans.subheadline: 点进单元格直接写，增删移动行列，让表格跟着计划调整。

en-US.headline: Type Markdown directly
en-US.subheadline: Type Markdown directly. Headings, lists, bold text, and code take shape as you write.

en-US.headline: Turn text into diagrams
en-US.subheadline: Write Mermaid to map a process. Edit the text to update your diagram.

en-US.headline: Math, with the thinking
en-US.subheadline: Keep LaTeX formulas beside the reasoning that makes them useful.

en-US.headline: Code alongside its context
en-US.subheadline: Keep highlighted code beside your explanations, ready for your next visit.

en-US.headline: Organize projects. Connect ideas.
en-US.subheadline: Give projects a home in folders, then connect ideas with tags and links.

en-US.headline: Find notes by meaning
en-US.subheadline: Describe what you remember. Find related notes with on-device semantic search.
en-US.footnote: Chinese and English supported. Encrypted notes are excluded from semantic indexing.

en-US.headline: Import docs. Export your work.
en-US.subheadline: Import PDFs and Word documents as editable notes; export Markdown, PDF, and more.
en-US.footnote: Supports text-based PDFs and Office documents. Complex layouts may change.

en-US.headline: Your edits merge automatically
en-US.subheadline: Edit on your own devices at once. Ordinary note text merges automatically.
en-US.footnote: Same Apple Account; enable iCloud sync. Encrypted notes retain concurrent versions.

en-US.headline: Custom themes, ready to share
en-US.subheadline: 22 freshly tuned themes. Customize colors, and import or export theme files.

en-US.headline: Edit tables, cell by cell
en-US.subheadline: Type into cells. Add or move rows and columns as your plans change.
